name: theme-manager help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:theme-manager. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Roll ticked
entries.text: Rolls ticked. Part of Theme manager.

entries.title: Pin this roll
entries.text: Pins this roll. Part of Theme manager.

entries.title: Apply this pinned roll
entries.text: Applies this pinned roll. Part of Theme manager.

entries.title: Save as asset
entries.text: Saves as asset. Nothing is kept until you tap it. Part of Theme manager.

entries.title: Themes
entries.text: Shows the “Themes” part of this screen. Part of Theme manager.

entries.title: Skin Builder
entries.text: Build a skin from slices. Every section of a skin (colours, design, layout, behaviour, typography, density, sizing, icons, controls, chrome, parts) is an asset of its own; drag one from the library into its slot in the pack template, or tap Pick then tap a slice. The whole console shows the pack live; After / Before switches the preview. Save, Apply, Export (a file with the sections inside), Import, Duplicate, or Load a skin to edit it.

entries.title: A slot
entries.text: One section of the pack. Pick or Swap opens the library on that section, Clear empties it, Save as asset keeps the current section (the chrome in force, the parts of the skin in force) as a slice of its own. Colours, design and layout are required.

entries.title: Slice library
entries.text: Every section asset the console has, built-in and saved, by section. Search by name or tag; hovering a slice shows it on the whole console.

entries.title: Sections to take
entries.text: When you apply a skin, tick the sections to take; a left-out section keeps what is in force now. A result drawn from more than one skin asks to be saved as a new skin (name, description, a thumbnail captured for you), or applied without saving.
